visual_action: A woman speaks directly to the camera. Behind her, an animated graphic with the title "House of Representatives Vote On A Bill To Create An Active Shooter Alert System" appears. The graphic, a semi-circle of dots representing legislators, fills in to show vote counts: first, blue dots representing Democrats voting yes, with the number 217, and then red dots for Republicans voting no, with the number 168.

cast.name: unnamed woman
cast.evidence: She is the sole speaker and narrator of the video.

cast.name: Republican Party
cast.evidence: The speaker states, "168 Republicans voted no." The on-screen text also reads, "168 REPUBLICANS VOTED NO." She also refers to "Ultra MAGA Republicans."

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The speaker says, "217 Democrats passed a bill," and wears a sweatshirt with the word "DEMOCRAT" mirrored. The on-screen text reads, "217 DEMOCRATS VOTED YES."

cast.name: House of Representatives
cast.evidence: The title of the graphic is "House of Representatives Vote On A Bill To Create An Active Shooter Alert System."

on_screen_text.text: House of Representatives Vote On A Bill To Create An Active Shooter Alert System

spoken_summary: A woman claims that Republicans are "out of step with the American people." She reports that 217 Democrats passed a bill for an "Amber-style" active shooter alert system, while 168 Republicans voted against it. She concludes by stating that "Ultra MAGA Republicans are too extreme to hold power."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of the woman's speech. There is no background music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot. The only edits are animated graphics that appear over the speaker's shoulder to display the vote counts.
central_claim: Republicans are extremists who oppose public safety because a majority of them in the House voted against creating an active shooter alert system that Democrats supported.
intended_effect: To make viewers angry with Republicans for voting against a public safety bill and to persuade them to support Democrats.
